draft.subject: Hardware and Electronics Intern role at NDimensions Labs
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am interested in the Hardware and Electronics Intern, Robotics role at NDimensions Labs, and I wanted to write to you because a product engineer sees how a robot goes from a prototype to something that works every time.

That is the part of the work I enjoy most. My capstone was a robot arm that picks objects by voice command, and I took it from a loose set of boards to a system that picked reliably, which meant documenting and fixing each failure along the way. I also led the coding team for a competition robot and owned its wiring and integration across the mechanical and design teams. I am looking for a hands on hardware role where that habit is useful.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
